profile_text.body:
Weights & Biases, founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, describes itself as an AI developer platform that serves as a system of record for training AI models and developing AI applications. The platform covers ML experiment tracking, model registry, and artifact lineage, and its W&B Weave product adds tracing, evaluation, and guardrails for LLMs and agents. The company states that its platform is certified under ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27017:2015, and ISO/IEC 27018:2019, and is compliant with SOC 2 and HIPAA standards, with alignment to GDPR requirements and support for NIST 800-53 compliance.

The held facts note that Weights & Biases has been acquired by CoreWeave, and that the company carries a California law exposure count of 175 cases, though no specific litigation details are recorded. No MCP server presence or SEC and patent filings are on record for the company at this time.
